title: Part 1 voltage ratio
description: Essential: Correctly states the voltage ratio for part (1) as 2/3 or equivalent simplified fraction.

title: Part 2 voltage ratio
description: Essential: Correctly states the voltage ratio for part (2) as 7/6 or equivalent simplified fraction.

title: Series circuit analysis
description: Important: For part (1), identifies that with S on and S' off, R1 and R2 are in series with equal current.

title: Parallel combination recognition
description: Important: For part (2), recognizes that with both switches on, R2 and R3 are in parallel, and this combination is in series with R1.

title: Ohm's Law application
description: Important: Applies V = IR correctly to relate voltages to resistances or equivalent resistances in both scenarios.

title: Equivalent resistance calculation
description: Optional: Shows correct calculation of the parallel equivalent resistance for R2 and R3 (12/7 Ω) for part (2).

title: Incorrect series assumption
description: Pitfall: Penalize if student treats R2 and R3 as being in series with each other in part (2).

title: Current assumption error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if student assumes currents through R1 and R2 are equal in part (2).
